A1.justification: Both PDFs describe JiSAM, and all ten pages of each are readable, including the figures, tables and equations. However, both end with references and omit the appendix they cite. V3 renumbers several appendix references, but the corresponding material cannot be compared.

before.justification: V1 reports original NuScenes detection experiments using CARLA synthetic data, including repeated-run results, motorcycle-label removal and component ablations in Figures 2–3 and Tables 1–2.

after.justification: V3 retains these original detection experiments and their reported outcomes in Figures 2–3 and Tables 1–2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same spherical-coordinate jittering, separate domain input blocks and bidirectional memory-based sectorized alignment. No algorithm, architecture, objective or inference change is documented.

E1.justification: Both versions use NuScenes real data and CARLA synthetic point clouds for 3D detection. The reduced-label evaluation and scenario withholding real motorcycle labels are unchanged.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain Transfusion trained with full or fewer labels. Table 1 retains the same additional detectors: VoxelNext, CenterPoint, Second and PointPillar.

E3.justification: The documented settings remain approximately 7,000 real and 80,000 synthetic samples, the same NuScenes split, mAP/NDS/category AP metrics and 100 training epochs. The motorcycle-label removal procedure and 50% synthetic-data ablation are also retained.

E4.justification: The visible component ablations, half-synthetic-data comparison and motorcycle case study are unchanged. However, the referenced appendix illustration of object point distributions is unavailable in both files; its renumbering from Figure 3 to Figure 2 cannot establish whether supplementary analysis changed.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten runs with ten different seeds for the main experiments and the same box-plot reporting. Both use a fixed OpenPCDet seed for the ablations.

E6.justification: All visible results match: Figures 2–3 contain identical plot images, and Tables 1–2 retain every numerical entry, including JiSAM's 63.95 mAP and 69.36 NDS. However, the referenced appendix dataset-statistics table is absent, so that numerical material cannot be compared.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, noise model, coordinate transformations, memory updates and alignment loss in Equations 1–11 are unchanged. No theorem, proof or mathematical correction is added.

C1.justification: Both versions claim comparable full-data detector performance using synthetic data and only 2.5% of real point clouds, plus detection of categories without real training labels. The claimed plug-and-play contribution is unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations involving synthetic-data diversity, truck abundance, limited motorcycle/bicycle assets and sparse returns are retained. Discussion of integration with other detectors and compatibility with LiDAR generative models is also unchanged.

D1.justification: V1 promises to release models and code; v3 states they are available and supplies a concrete JiSAM repository hyperlink in the abstract. The documented implementation settings remain unchanged. The linked resources themselves were not accessed.

R1.justification: The same 46 references and substantive related-work positioning are retained. No cited work or claimed relationship to earlier research is added or removed.

P1.justification: V3 adds Ping Luo's HKU Shanghai Intelligent Computing Research Center affiliation, revises the release sentence and renumbers three appendix references. The main section organization and scientific prose otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The supplied pages show only minor typography, spacing and text-flow changes; the three main figures and two tables retain their displays and content. Changes to the referenced appendix figure and table cannot be assessed because neither appendix is supplied.

improvement.justification: The visible revision provides a small benefit by replacing a future release promise with concrete code/model access information, while retaining the scientific argument and reported results. However, the omitted appendices and changed references to them prevent a reliable assessment of the requested full-paper revision.
